title: 第17章 修仙尽头是房地产第18章 这位更是重量级
lines: 皇宫。
深夜，白羽逮住一个伺候皇帝的太监。
“我问你答，不要有多余的废话，听明白了吗？”
脖子被掐住，太监连忙点头。
白羽：“皇帝一直在寝宫里待了多久？”
太监：“将…将近两个月，昨日才走出寝宫。”
白羽：“在他出来之前，有没有什么奇怪的人进去，又或者有什么奇怪的举动？”
太监思索了一会儿，才答道：“似是有一人进了陛下寝宫，但我也没具体看见，当时那班岗不是我站的。
我那同僚说一个月以前有一人从天而降，直接就进了陛下寝宫，然后就一直没见过了，我觉得他是在吹牛……”
一问一答，问清楚以后，白羽把他给打晕就走了。
回到曾经待过的小院里，这边儿还是一切如常，没人来过。
那修真者该是走了。
琢磨着，白羽来到凉亭坐下。
所谓神秘力量其实就是修真者，赵国实际上就是一个由修真势力控制的国度。
否则它凭什么躲过王朝兴衰交替？
这些也是白羽去了紫云仙宗下辖坊市才知道的。
原来，每一个皇朝背后实际都有一个筑基势力控制。
比如赵国，它实际上就是一个修仙家族赵氏控制，家族里绝对有一位筑基老祖。
在赵国还有一支神秘的队伍，他们只管拿着类似于探测仪的东西在国境内到处跑。
全年无休，全国搜索，但凡与修真者有关的珍宝都会被收集起来等到筑基家族派人来取。
一千年呐，这个赵家也是很了不起的家族了，族中的筑基大能千年不断。
筑基大能，三百年寿终，这赵家至少连续不断出了四位筑基大能。
这些筑基势力为什么要控制区区凡俗皇朝？
当然是为了资源，凡俗里也有着低级修真者需要的资源。
再一个，掌控大片土地还有机会成为坊市主。
一旦国土境内有灵脉孕育而出，这些家族势力就会立马扑过来安装防御大阵和攻击大阵，届时便可以成为地主坐等收租。
所以说，修仙的尽头还是房产，坊市主都是开发商。
圈地建造，压榨底层修真者。
哪怕是最低级的灵脉，顷刻间也能将方圆千里化作修仙圣地。
一支势力占据这么一个坊市，焉能不崛起？
有人抢地盘是肯定的，但倘若提前准备好阵法，提前布置好的话，其实一位筑基大能就能守住。
金丹不出手，后患无忧。
当然，一般金丹修士也是看不上这种低级灵脉。
他们，一般都是建一座城来压榨修真者，筑基也得被他们压榨。
不是所有筑基修士都能掌控一个皇朝。
有的孤家寡人不行，有的是因为看不上，有的是因为抢不过。
总之一句话，能有凡俗皇朝控制，多半都是一些筑基大族。
赵氏明显就是一个筑基大族，虽然他们不一定是坊市主，但千年筑基不断就证明了实力。
倘若境内再出现灵脉，不说眺望金丹，起码筑基的族人能源源不断产出，成为一个筑基大族。
白羽以前听说过，有的筑基大族哪怕有百位筑基大能，但却始终没人能迈向下一步。
这就修仙的残酷，比前世高考更残酷。
content_en:
royal palace.
Late at night, Bai Yu caught an eunuch serving the emperor.
"I'm asking you to answer, no unnecessary nonsense, do you understand?"
His neck was pinched, and the eunuch nodded quickly.
Bai Yu: "How long has the emperor been staying in the palace?"
Eunuch: "It will be... nearly two months. I just walked out of the palace yesterday."
Bai Yu: "Before he came out, was there any strange person in, or any strange behavior?"
"This..."
The eunuch thought for a while and then replied: "It seems that someone entered His Majesty's palace, but I didn't see it specifically. I was not on duty at that time.
My colleague said that a man fell from the sky a month ago and went straight into His Majesty's palace, and he was never seen again. I think he was bragging..."
After asking and answering questions, Bai Yu knocked him out and left.
Returning to the small courtyard where I had stayed, everything was still business as usual, no one came.
It's time for the cultivator to leave.
After thinking about it, Bai Yu came to the pavilion and sat down.
The so-called mysterious forces are actually cultivators, and Zhao State is actually a country controlled by cultivating forces.
Otherwise, how could it escape the rise and fall of dynasties?
Bai Yu only found out about this when he went to the city under the jurisdiction of Ziyun Immortal Sect.
It turns out that behind every dynasty there is actually a foundation-building force controlling it.
For example, the State of Zhao is actually controlled by the Zhao family, a family that cultivates immortality. There is definitely a foundation-building ancestor in the family.
There is also a mysterious team in Zhao State. They just run around the country with something similar to a detector.
There is a nationwide search all year round, and all treasures related to cultivators will be collected until someone from the Establishment Family comes to collect them.
After a thousand years, the Zhao family has become a great family, and the family's foundation-building ability has continued for thousands of years.
A great foundation-building expert, with a lifespan of three hundred years. The Zhao family has produced at least four great foundation-building experts in a row.
Why do these foundation-building forces control mere mortal dynasties?
Of course, it is for resources. There are also resources that low-level cultivators need in the ordinary world.
Another one is that if you control a large area of ​​land, you will have the opportunity to become the market owner.
Once spiritual veins are born in the territory, these family forces will immediately rush over to install defensive and offensive formations. At that time, they can become landlords and wait to collect rent.
Therefore, the end of cultivating immortality is still real estate, and all market owners are developers.
Enclosure construction exploits cultivators at the bottom.
Even the lowest level of spiritual veins can turn a thousand miles around into a holy land for cultivating immortals in an instant.
If a force occupies such a small city, how can it not rise?
It is certain that someone will grab the territory, but if the formation is prepared and arranged in advance, a foundation-building expert can actually hold it.
If you don’t use the golden elixir, you won’t have to worry about future troubles.
Of course, most golden elixir cultivators also looked down upon such low-level spiritual veins.
They usually build a city to exploit the cultivators, and they also have to exploit the foundations.
Not all foundation-building monks can control a dynasty.
Some of them can't do it alone, some because they don't like it, and some because they can't get it.
In a word, those who can be controlled by mortal dynasties are probably some powerful foundation-building clans.
The Zhao family is obviously a big foundation-building family. Although they are not necessarily the masters of the city, their strength has been proven by their continuous foundation-building for thousands of years.
If spiritual veins appear again in the territory, not to mention the Golden Pill, at least the people of the Foundation Establishment clan will continue to produce energy and become a large Foundation Establishment clan.
Bai Yu had heard before that even if some great foundation-building clans had hundreds of great foundation-building experts, no one could take the next step.
This is the cruelty of cultivating immortality, even more cruel than the college entrance examination in the previous life.
